mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fitness_consult (center_no, partner_id, customer_name, customer_phone, memo, status) VALUES (#{centerNo}, (SELECT member_id FROM fitness_center WHERE center_no = #{centerNo}), #{customerName}, #{customerPhone}, #{memo}, 0)
INSERT INTO fitness_phone_stats (center_no, stats_date, copy_count) VALUES (#{centerNo}, CURDATE(), 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE copy_count = copy_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(fps.copy_count), 0) FROM fitness_phone_stats fps JOIN fitness_center fc ON fps.center_no = fc.center_no WHERE fc.member_id = #{partnerId} AND fps.stats_date = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fitness_consult WHERE partner_id = #{partnerId} AND status = 0

SELECT fc.consult_no as consultNo, fc.center_no as centerNo, c.center_name as centerName, fc.customer_name as customerName, fc.customer_phone as customerPhone, fc.memo as memo, DATE_FORMAT(fc.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as regDate, fc.status as status, fc.partner_memo as partnerMemo FROM fitness_consult fc JOIN fitness_center c ON fc.center_no = c.center_no WHERE fc.partner_id = #{partnerId} ORDER BY fc.status ASC, fc.consult_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fitness_consult SET status = 1 WHERE consult_no = #{consultNo} AND partner_id = #{partnerId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fps.stats_date, '%m-%d') as dateLabel, SUM(fps.copy_count) as cnt FROM fitness_phone_stats fps JOIN fitness_center fc ON fps.center_no = fc.center_no WHERE fc.member_id = #{partnerId} AND fps.stats_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY fps.stats_date ORDER BY fps.stats_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(reg_date, '%m-%d') as dateLabel, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM fitness_consult WHERE partner_id = #{partnerId} AND reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(reg_date, '%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(reg_date) ASC
